title: Resolution width from narrow-clause threshold and simultaneous wide-clause count
work: Polynomial Calculus Space and Resolution Width
difficulty_reason: The author argument couples a first falsified narrow clause with a last configuration admitting a small extension that satisfies every wide clause, rather than simply translating a space bound into width. Its contradiction crosses the resulting proof interval in both directions and tracks the partial-assignment budget through two resolution inferences using an Atserias--Dalmau family. This new wide-clause-count theorem is a nonroutine proof-complexity construction above ordinary qualification exercises; the ensuing total-space corollary and cited width-space theorem are supporting context only.
